fd001.aurc_reporting_guidance: Do not present the single endpoint-ID-tiebroken FD001 AURC as a uniquely defined quantity. Prefer the tie-sensitivity distribution and/or threshold-attainable curve, noting that all 20,000 sampled tie orders remained better than the random-ranking reference.
fd001.claim_boundary: Report as supportive/directional evidence; do not claim a 95%-level statistically conclusive selective improvement.
fd001.interpretation: The frozen FD001 selective policy produced a favorable held-out point estimate and meaningful matched-random separation. Endpoint-bootstrap directional stability was high, but the 95% percentile interval for selective MAE gain included zero. Risk-ranking advantage remained below the random-ranking nAURC reference across all sampled within-tie orderings, although the precise AURC magnitude is sensitive to the large number of tied risk values.

fd002.claim_boundary: Strong held-out evidence conditional on the frozen trained model/policy; bootstrap results do not quantify retraining or random-seed variability.
fd002.interpretation: The frozen FD002 reliability policy shows strong held-out error separation. The uncertainty-selected accepted subset outperformed matched random rejection at the same coverage, the endpoint-bootstrap selective-gain interval remained strictly positive, and the nAURC ranking advantage was essentially insensitive to tied-risk ordering.

fd003.interpretation: The original frozen held-out negative result remains authoritative. No row-level post-hoc reconstruction or new selective analysis was performed.

fd004.interpretation: Held-out TEST remains unscored under the frozen fixed-window protocol because short TEST trajectories violated the original evaluation admissibility contract.

global_claim: Reliability-aware selective prediction produced useful error separation in FD001 and especially FD002, but the benefit was not universal: FD003 remained a held-out negative counterexample and FD004 remained structurally unscored under the frozen protocol.
prohibited_claims: formal model-training significance from endpoint bootstrap
a uniquely defined FD001 AURC despite tied risk values
